annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/989 of 18 May 2018 amending and correcting Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/654 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 with regard to technical and general requirements relating to emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/989 of 18 May 2018 amending and correcting Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/654 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 with regard to technical and general requirements relating to emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 182/61, 18.7.2018
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation amending and correcting Delegated Regulation 2017/654 on emission limits and type-approval technical requirements for internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery (fuel specs, deterioration factors, emission control strategies, test procedures). It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Raises permitted FAME content of reference non-road diesel from 7.0% to 8.0% v/v
Transitional provision: type-approvals under the previous version allowed until 31 Dec 2018, market placement until 30 June 2019
Adds deterioration factor rules for engines without after-treatment and regeneration provisions for testing
Requires demonstration reports in the manufacturer's information folder
Corrects numerous technical test procedure and calculation provisions
